detail: HUD controls do not overlap and settings categories keep touch targets across six viewport/safe-area geometries
initial music discovery and ID/link input coexist in a compact panel with readable list and 44px controls in portrait/landscape
native temporary examples are labelled, adapt to multiple horizontal rows, disappear on a real publication notification and keep favorites/IA routing separate
opening publish starts a native name/filter picker with immediate examples; selecting a result still requires server confirmation before free publication
Todos/Grátis are the only modes, pending player thumbnails display without waiting for every 3D body, and explicit prices are sent to the real combined endpoint
negative/reversed prices cannot close or execute a filter; default catalog includes free items; active-filter count and explicit 2D/3D clothing labels match native parameters
five distinct original scene motifs exist and a reusable 25-part local floor follows long-distance movement; no collisions/query changes and cleanup restores the world
official store thumbnail/raw-image backgrounds remain behind the exact copied model; asymmetric sidebars no longer shift the avatar horizontally; invalid replacement preserves the prior scene
result keeps the board available, displays session score, uses explicit review/replay/next actions and avoids the Roblox topbar in every tested geometry
actual music LocalScript retrieves native defaults, starts the verified background audio at 40%, populates a queue before manual input and advances to the next track
the actual game LocalScript holds the last board/result through room closure; review hides the summary while keeping the final board available
small native emote sidebar directs testing to the copied-avatar callback and opens only Roblox purchase for an available catalog item
